title: District 21 SMP
body:
This modpack is originally created for the District 21 Survival Multiplayer (SMP) server, but it is perfect for anyone looking to play with their friends!

Are you completely new to modded Minecraft? Don't worry! This modpack is specifically designed as a "Vanilla+" experience for beginners. We carefully selected mods that enhance the base game without overwhelming you with complicated machines, confusing magic systems, or a steep learning curve. It feels just like a massive, official Minecraft update!

✨ Key Features
🌍 Enhanced Exploration: Discover breathtaking new biomes, completely overhauled world generation, and exciting new dungeons and structures to conquer with your friends.
🌾 Farming & Food: Grow a huge variety of new crops, build your own cozy kitchen, and cook delicious new meals.
🐺 Alive & Breathing World: Encounter new realistic wildlife, diverse creature variants.
🪑 Cozy Decorations: Unleash your inner builder! Decorate your base with beautiful new furniture, windows, doors, roofs, and cute plushies.
⚡ Highly Optimized: Packed with the best performance-boosting mods (like Sodium, etc.) to ensure a smooth, lag-free multiplayer experience, even on lower-end PCs!
🤝 Perfect for Multiplayer
Everything in this pack is chosen to encourage cooperation. Build a lively town, trade new foods, or explore dangerous dungeons together. Just install, join the server, and start your enhanced Minecraft journey!
